title: Finite density gives a natural-number small-ball mass bound
statement: Let N, n ∈ ℕ, let μ be a measure on ℝ^N = Euclidean N, x ∈ ℝ^N and θ ∈ [0, ∞) with HasDensity n μ x θ. That is, densityRatio n μ x ρ = μ(B_ρ(x)) / (ω_n · ENNReal.ofReal(ρ)^n) → θ as ρ ↓ 0, with ω_n = unitBallVolume n, ENNReal division and B_ρ(x) the closed ball. Then there are K, j ∈ ℕ such that μ(B_ρ(x)) ≤ K · ENNReal.ofReal(ρ)^n for every real ρ with 0 < ρ ≤ 1/(j+1).
lean_statement: ∀ (N n : ℕ) (μ : Measure (Euclidean N)) (x : Euclidean N) (θ : ℝ≥0∞), θ ≠ ∞ → HasDensity n μ x θ → ∃ K j : ℕ, ∀ ρ : ℝ, 0 < ρ → ρ ≤ 1 / ((j : ℝ) + 1) → μ (closedBall x ρ) ≤ (K : ℝ≥0∞) * ENNReal.ofReal ρ ^ n
